title: Writer-R1: Dynamic Rubric Mining for Reinforcement Learning of Open-Ended Writing
abstract: arXiv:2603.15061v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Training models for open-ended writing requires diverse prompts and sufficiently precise specifications of response quality. Constructing such specifications at scale entails recovering task requirements, consolidating overlapping criteria, and defining observable differences between performance levels. We introduce Writer-R1, a writing training pipeline built around Inductive Rubric Generation (IRG), which integrates these operations into an automated rubric construction procedure. The pipeline expands an open writing corpus and uses the resulting prompt-specific rubrics throughout supervised training and reinforcement learning (RL). Each rubric is concatenated with the user request and also defines the reward criteria, making the requirements used for assessment available to the writer before generation. A compact model, RubricGen-4B, learns to supply rubrics for new requests. Writer-R1 improves WritingBench scores by 0.182 and 0.1

translated_title: Writer-R1：面向开放式写作强化学习的动态评分标准挖掘
translated_abstract: 训练开放式写作模型需要多样化的提示词以及对回答质量足够精确的规范说明。大规模构建此类规范涉及恢复任务需求、整合重叠的评判标准，以及定义不同表现水平之间可观测的差异。我们提出了 Writer-R1，一个围绕归纳式评分标准生成（IRG）构建的写作训练流程，它将这些操作整合为一个自动化的评分标准构建程序。该流程扩展了一个开放式写作语料库，并在监督训练和强化学习（RL）全过程中使用由此生成的针对特定提示词的评分标准。每个评分标准与用户请求拼接在一起，同时定义奖励标准，使得用于评估的要求在生成之前即可被写作模型获取。一个紧凑的模型 RubricGen-4B 学习为新的请求提供评分标准。Writer-R1 将 WritingBench 分数分别提升了 0.182 和 0.1...
tldr: Writer-R1 提出基于归纳式评分标准生成（IRG）的自动化流程，为开放式写作任务动态挖掘针对特定提示词的评分标准，并将其同时用于监督训练、强化学习奖励定义与写作前置指导，显著提升了模型写作质量。
